race.comment: LOTSAMERIT (11) has the sharper local profile, with a win from two starts at this track and a previous win around this distance, while her Belmont C3 effort reads better than tenth on paper after she charged home from well back. CALEB (4) resumes with a prior win at this venue and Troy Turner back aboard, so he can rebound from two plain C2 runs that ended his last campaign. ROMANCE CALLING (5) is race-fit and improved sharply when third at this track last start despite interference, making her a genuine danger if she takes another step third-up. LADY MAYFLOWER (9) won't be far away in a suitable race.
